|translation='''Title:''' Han's Heavy Blaster Pistol.

'''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy on Han, or 3 Force to deploy on another warrior. Use 1 Force to fire. Draw destiny. Hit a character if destiny +1 exceeds ability, or a vehicle if destiny +1 exceeds maneuver or armor. If Han hits the target, its forfeit becomes 0.

'''Lore:''' A BlasTech DL-44 heavy blaster. It has a short range but is correspondingly powerful. It holds enough energy for 25 shots. Most systems ban or restrict ownership.
